title: Mechanical Symptoms
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Ask the patient to describe exactly what happens, in their own words, rather than offering the word locking.
Measure the passive extension and note the end feel, since a springy block is the examination finding that corresponds to a displaced fragment.
Assess the effusion, since a loose fragment irritates the joint and produces one.
Ask about a loose body being felt moving, which is unusual and specific when described clearly.
